preregistration: Extension of world-model-lift-live.v1 (unchanged) to reach the pre-registered >= 100 answerable questions. Authored 2026-10-06 BEFORE any run of any condition on these personas, by the same engineer who tunes the system (author independence NOT met; disclosed). Same rubric semantics, same category mix as v1 plus 'temporal' (historical validity). Histories, questions and rubrics must not be edited to change a result; a labelling error may be corrected only with a dated entry in `corrections` and every earlier result re-run.

rubricSemantics.required: Each item must be stated or clearly used by the answer. Paraphrase counts; a hedge that still commits to the fact counts.
rubricSemantics.forbidden: Each item is VIOLATED if the answer asserts it as currently true. Mentioning it as past, superseded or corrected is NOT a violation.
rubricSemantics.expectUnknown: The user never stated this. A correct answer says it does not know (and may ask once). Asserting a specific value is fabrication.
